source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 9 June 1955, p. 5 ("Notice of result of elections: Newry No. 1 Rural District")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Votes as printed in the official notice; 178-109=69, and the two parties sum to the valid poll of 287.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. The only contest was in Hilltown; the other divisions were uncontested and are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (Belfast News-Letter, 9 June 1955, p. 5). The Carrickcrossan entry in the notice is too badly damaged in the OCR to transcribe and is omitted. Fegan was the outgoing member; the newspaper report had misprinted the majority as 89.
